homePage.heroTitle: Your Next Literary Adventure Starts Here.
homePage.heroSubtitle: Dive into a universe of stories. Buy fresh releases, find pre-loved treasures, or swap books with our passionate community of readers. Shelf Swap is your companion in literary exploration.
homePage.howItWorksSubtitle: Discover, share, and connect in three simple steps.
homePage.howItWorksStep1Desc: Browse a vast collection or list your own books for sale or swap easily.
homePage.howItWorksStep2Desc: Make offers on books you love or propose swaps with other members.
homePage.howItWorksStep3Desc: Chat with users, finalize deals, and enjoy your new literary adventures!
